errors.action_or_position: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Moving/approving a queue item with a malformed request; action, approve, reject, position are API field names — keep them.
errors.app_closing: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). The app window asked for something while the app shuts down.
errors.autostart_failed: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings: switching "start with Windows" failed; {detail} is the system error.
errors.bad_request: API error (panel player controls): generic text of the code bad_request; answers usually carry a more specific text.
errors.body_too_large: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Technical (request over 16 KB); the same English text in every language (API compatibility).
errors.busy: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): a second operation was started while one runs.
errors.cancelled: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): the owner cancelled the Cloudflare login.
errors.certificate_save_failed: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): saving the login certificate failed; {reason} is the system error.
errors.cloudflared_start: Tunnel error (app window, tunnel status and wizard): the cloudflared program would not start; {detail} is the system error.
errors.cookies_by_picker: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings: the cookies file can only be chosen with the file picker.
errors.credentials_fetch_failed: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): {tunnel} is the tunnel name (vrcinema), {reason} what cloudflared said.
errors.credentials_invalid: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): the tunnel credentials file is unusable.
errors.credentials_save_failed: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): {reason} is the system error.
errors.dns_route_failed: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): {hostname} is the chosen address, {reason} what cloudflared said.
errors.dns_taken: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): the chosen address already has a DNS record; the window then offers to replace it.
errors.domain_not_allowed: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Request page: the link is from a site not on the list; {domains} is a comma-separated list of domains.
errors.empty_json_body: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Technical; the same English text in every language (API compatibility).
errors.empty_playlist: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel: an added playlist has no playable entries.
errors.engine_unavailable: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel player controls (pause, seek, restart, play now) while the channel loop is busy or restarting.
errors.failed: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): an operation ended unexpectedly; {detail} is a technical cause. Also the generic message of the error code "failed".
errors.fetch_failed: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Request page: the link could not be read; {reason} is a message from yt-dlp or the site (often English) or another errors.* message.
errors.ffmpeg_missing: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings: encoder test without ffmpeg installed.
errors.field_not_boolean: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Malformed settings request; {field} is an API field name.
errors.field_not_text: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Malformed settings request; {field} is an API field name.
errors.file_missing: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Files from disk: the file is gone; {name} is a file name.
errors.file_paths_unavailable: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Files dropped on the window are not supported in this mode.
errors.folder_unreadable: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel, files from disk: a media folder cannot be read.
errors.folder_unreadable_detail: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel, files from disk; {detail} is the system error.
errors.hostname_invalid: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): the typed address is not a valid host name; the example may be adapted.
errors.hostname_required: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): no address was typed; the example may be adapted.
errors.internal: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Unexpected server failure (details only in the log).
errors.invalid: Permanent-link wizard (app window): a malformed request; also the generic text of the code invalid.
errors.invalid_disk_file_url: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Files from disk: malformed internal file address.
errors.invalid_json: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Technical; the same English text in every language (API compatibility).
errors.invalid_link: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Request page and panel: the text entered is not an http(s) link.
errors.invalid_path: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel, files from disk: a malformed path.
errors.invalid_port: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings: the port field.
errors.invalid_public_url: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings: the public address field.
errors.invalid_settings: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings: the request is not an object of settings.
errors.invalid_tunnel_mode: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings; quick and named are API values — keep them.
errors.invalid_url: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). {url} is the link that could not be parsed.
errors.invalid_window_key: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). The app window opened with an expired or wrong one-time key (rare; plain page text).
errors.item_finished: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel: removing a queue item that already played.
errors.item_id_required: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel "play now" with a malformed request; itemId is an API field name — keep it.
errors.library_disabled: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Headless server panel; MEDIA_DIRS and .env are names — keep them.
errors.live_item: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel player controls while a live stream plays.
errors.live_owner_only: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Request page: a viewer sent a live stream link.
errors.local_files_disabled: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). A disk file was requested without media folders; MEDIA_DIRS and .env are names — keep them.
errors.local_not_a_video: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel, files from disk: the chosen file is not a video; {name} is the file name.
errors.login_failed: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): {reason} is what cloudflared said (English) or named.no_reason.
errors.login_interrupted: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): {reason} is the system error.
errors.login_no_certificate: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): the login ended without a certificate.
errors.login_required: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel request without a valid session.
errors.login_timeout: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): {duration} is a duration like "5 min" (units.*).
errors.move_only_queued: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel: moving an item that is not queued.
errors.named_files_left: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): deleting the permanent link left files behind; {detail} is the system error.
errors.named_link_first: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings: switching to the permanent link before setting it up; the path names the window's sections — use their translated names.
errors.named_operation_running: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings → Tools: updating cloudflared while the permanent-link wizard runs.
errors.no_cloudflared: Tunnel status and wizard (app window): the cloudflared program is not installed; "Tools" is the name of the settings section.
errors.no_domain: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): the account has no domain or the address is outside it; shown with a help link.
errors.no_domain_record: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): like errors.no_domain, plus the wrong DNS record {record} Cloudflare created.
errors.no_public_address: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). App window: the QR code was asked for before the channel has an address.
errors.no_segment: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). A video player asked for a stream segment that is gone (technical).
errors.no_such_item: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel: the queue item does not exist (any more).
errors.no_such_root: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel, files from disk: an unknown media folder.
errors.no_update: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). About: installing an update when none is offered.
errors.no_videos_in_folder: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel, files from disk: adding an empty folder.
errors.not_a_folder: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel, files from disk: listing a file as a folder.
errors.not_a_video_file: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Files dropped on the window: {name} is the file name.
errors.not_logged_in: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): a step needs the Cloudflare login first; the quoted step name must match the wizard's button.
errors.not_pending: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel moderation: approving an item that is not pending.
errors.not_playable_now: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel "play now" on an item that is neither queued nor in the history.
errors.nothing_playing: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel player controls when no video plays.
errors.page_not_found: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). A page of the program is missing (technical).
errors.password_first: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings: switching on the remote panel without a password.
errors.password_save_failed: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings; {detail} is a technical cause.
errors.password_too_short: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings: remote panel password; {min} is a number (8).
errors.path_outside_library: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel, files from disk: a path escaping the media folder.
errors.pixeldrain_bad_answer: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Reading a pixeldrain link; "pixeldrain" is a site name.
errors.pixeldrain_bad_link: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Reading a pixeldrain link; /u/ and /l/ are URL parts — keep them.
errors.pixeldrain_connection: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Reading a pixeldrain link; {detail} is the network error.
errors.pixeldrain_list: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). A pixeldrain list was played directly.
errors.pixeldrain_not_video: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Reading a pixeldrain link; {name} is the file name.
errors.pixeldrain_read: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Reading a pixeldrain link; {detail} is the network error.
errors.pixeldrain_unavailable: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Reading a pixeldrain link; {status} is an HTTP status number.
errors.playlist_owner_only: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Request page: a viewer sent a playlist link.
errors.process_timeout: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). A helper program (yt-dlp) ran too long; {command} is its name.
errors.qr_failed: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). App window, share view; {detail} is a technical cause.
errors.read_failed: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel: an added link could not be read; {reason} is a message from yt-dlp or the site, or another errors.* message.
errors.remote_panel_off: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Remote panel login page while remote access is off.
errors.restart_failed: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). App window "restart channel"; {detail} is a technical cause.
errors.restart_reverted: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings: new port or network access failed; {detail} is a technical cause.
errors.seek_seconds: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel seek with a malformed or too large number.
errors.seek_target: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel seek with a malformed request; toS and byS are API field names — keep them.
errors.seek_unknown_length: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel seek backwards in a video of unknown length.
errors.server_start_failed: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings; {detail} is a technical cause.
errors.setting_not_boolean: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel channel settings; {key} is a setting name.
errors.setting_not_list: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel channel settings; {key} is a setting name.
errors.setting_not_number: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel channel settings; {key} is a setting name.
errors.settings_not_object: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel channel settings: malformed request.
errors.settings_save_failed: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). App settings could not be written; {path} is the file, {detail} the system error.
errors.source_message: A message from outside the program (yt-dlp, a website, the system), shown as it is; used as {reason} in other messages. Keep just the field.
errors.timeout: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): a cloudflared command took too long.
errors.too_long: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Request page; {limit} is a duration like "2 h 0 min" (units.*).
errors.too_many_active: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Request page: the viewer reached the limit of queued videos; {count} is that limit. (Polish keeps the original wording in every form for API compatibility.)
errors.too_many_logins: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Remote panel login.
errors.too_many_requests: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Request page: rate limit.
errors.tools_busy: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): refused while the tools job replaces cloudflared.
errors.tools_running: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings → Tools: a second download was started.
errors.tunnel_create_failed: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): {tunnel} is the tunnel name, {reason} what cloudflared said.
errors.tunnel_delete_failed: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): {tunnel} is the tunnel name, {reason} what cloudflared said.
errors.tunnel_folder_failed: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): {reason} is the system error.
errors.tunnel_off: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). App window: restarting the tunnel while it is off.
errors.unknown_encoder: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings; {encoder} is the value sent.
errors.unknown_setting: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel channel settings; {key} is the setting name sent.
errors.unknown_tool: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings → Tools; {tool} is the value sent.
errors.unsupported_media_type: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Technical; the same English text in every language (API compatibility).
errors.update_failed: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). About: installing a new version failed; {detail} is a technical cause.
errors.update_running: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). About: a second install was started.
errors.update_unavailable: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). About: a build that cannot update itself.
errors.window_only: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Remote panel asked for an app-window-only feature.
errors.wrong_password: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Remote panel login.
errors.ytdlp_bad_data: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Reading a link; yt-dlp is a program name.
errors.ytdlp_no_stream: Reason a video failed (history in the panel); yt-dlp is a program name.
errors.ytdlp_unknown: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Reading a link failed without a reason from yt-dlp.
item_errors.ffmpeg_exit: Reason a video failed, kept in the history (panel); ffmpeg is a program name, {code} its exit code.
item_errors.ffmpeg_stopped: Reason a video failed, kept with it in the history (panel). ffmpeg is a program name. Short.
item_errors.internal: Reason a video failed (it kept crashing the channel), kept in the history. Short.
item_errors.no_video: Reason a video failed, kept in the history (panel).
item_errors.probe_failed: Reason a video failed, kept in the history (panel); ffprobe is a program name and printed no reason.
item_errors.skipped: Kept with a skipped video in the history (panel). Impersonal, short (max ~30 characters).
item_errors.stalled: Reason a video failed, kept in the history (panel).
item_errors.start_timeout: Reason a video failed, kept in the history (panel).
item_errors.unknown: Reason a video failed without a known cause, kept in the history. Short.
named.back_to_quick: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): result notice after "back to the quick tunnel".
named.deleted: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): result notice after deleting the permanent link; {hostname} is its address.
named.deleted_no_host: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): like named.deleted when the address is not known.
named.logged_in: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): result of step 1 (login).
named.logged_in_before: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): result of step 1 when an older certificate was reused; .cloudflared is a folder name.
named.no_reason: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): used as {reason} when cloudflared printed nothing.
named.ready: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): result of step 2; {url} is the new address.
named.step.creating_tunnel: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): progress line; {tunnel} is the tunnel name.
named.step.deleting: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): progress line.
named.step.fetching_credentials: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): progress line.
named.step.routing_dns: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): progress line; {hostname} is the chosen address.
named.step.starting: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): progress line.
named.step.switching: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): progress line.
named.step.waiting_for_browser: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): progress line while the browser login page is open.
slates.buffering_subtitle: Stream slate (drawn into the video, 1920 px wide, large font): subtitle under "Buffering…". Max ~40 characters.
slates.buffering_title: Stream slate title while a video loads. Max ~30 characters.
slates.connecting: Stream slate (idle): subtitle while the tunnel connects. Max ~40 characters.
slates.idle_hint: Stream slate (idle): subtitle when there is no public address. Max ~40 characters.
slates.pause_title: Stream slate shown while the channel is paused. Max ~30 characters.
tunnel.fetching: Tunnel status reason (app window, Settings → Internet).
units.hours_minutes: A duration with hours and minutes, inside other messages (e.g. errors.too_long).
units.minutes: A duration in minutes, inside other messages.
units.seconds: A duration in seconds, inside other messages.
